command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The all-link amdxio operation is directionally correct, but insecure SSH and tail truncation are unacceptable. It omits the source targeted-link option and does not resolve malformed `-lanes<LINKNAME>:0.15` syntax.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the verified AMD recipe to select exactly one approved all-link or target manifest, capture full linkstatus/margin output and CSV, and parse the engineer-resolved column schema against unique lane topology.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: -xgmi -linkstatus, -margin -xgmi -all, ber=10, errcnt=5, optional index/link lanes 0..15, xgmi_4PT_margin_all CSV, 2x16=32 example and 15/10-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an immutable lane manifest from linkstatus, bind every expected CSV row to link/lane identity and validate a vendor-defined column schema plus post-run health under one maintenance-window run.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure complete capture, explicit command grammar/scope, unique-lane validation and recovery while preserving all source parameters.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Total rows can be satisfied by duplicates, and duplicate column labels cannot identify which margins were checked. Both lane identity and an unambiguous schema are needed before non-zero PASS/FAIL automation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Margining exercises receiver edges and can destabilize XGMI or generate RAS events. Vendor tool/output semantics may vary, so no placeholder or field position may be inferred.

project_override_considerations: If the duplicate labels were intended to include vertical up/down or other 4-point fields, the approved schema must name each exact column/unit and map every source criterion without silently dropping a dimension.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and engineering decision on targeted syntax/CSV schema
SUT/GPU/XGMI/firmware/driver/amdxio identity and full linkstatus-derived lane manifest
Owner approval, maintenance/no-load audit and exact command/parameters
Full stdout/stderr/status plus raw CSV/hash and unique lane row/count result
Per-row resolved phase/volt/left/right-or-approved fields with zero-cell report
Pre/post XGMI/RAS/thermal/power/host health, no-log-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criteria lists Margin Left and Margin Right twice and omits unambiguous names for all required 4-point fields, while targeted Procedure syntax `-lanes<LINKNAME>:0.15` is incomplete/malformed. Automation cannot know which cells or exact command satisfy the source without an approved vendor mapping.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The ambiguity blocks execution/verdict but is fully isolated as an engineering decision; static review and subsequent cases can continue.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 1974 Wistron-AMD SVM-00140-V003: provide the exact supported targeted amdxio grammar for index/link/lane range (source shows `-lanes<LINKNAME>:0.15`), define all required xgmi_4PT CSV column names/units replacing the duplicated Margin Left/Right labels, and confirm the unique lane-count/non-zero acceptance contract plus any additional thresholds.

review_improvement: Makes malformed command and ambiguous field schema explicit, prevents row duplicates from hiding missing lanes and preserves full interconnect health evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source's PASS/FAIL is cell-based, so duplicate column labels are not cosmetic: a parser could validate the same column twice while ignoring another dimension. Likewise, a targeted command with missing delimiter cannot be repaired from generic CLI intuition because the vendor tool may interpret link and lane selectors differently. The all-link path remains package-gated but still requires a lane identity manifest; row count alone cannot distinguish complete coverage from duplicate rows. A single bounded run is required because rerunning after instability could compound link/RAS faults.
